vpp_mod_suite.chalk.desc: Chalk particles are saved to the original Chalk configuration.
vpp_mod_suite.chalk.emitParticles.desc: Show Chalk particles. This changes the original Chalk EmitParticles setting and preserves its existing file.
tooltip.vpp_mod_suite.magnet: Put in your Tool Pouch: 6-block pickup range.
tooltip.vpp_mod_suite.collector: Put in your Tool Pouch: collect into your backpack.
tooltip.vpp_mod_suite.toggle: Toggle with your backpack pickup hotkey.
vpp_mod_suite.features.desc: Configure independently maintained Vanilla++ gameplay features. Server settings synchronize to players.
Route pickups into a shulker box held in the offhand. Full boxes leave items for the backpack or inventory.
vpp_mod_suite.features.shulkerBeforeBack: When both pickup destinations are available, fill the offhand shulker first. Disable to fill the backpack first.
vpp_mod_suite.features.beaconPlacement.d: Use beacon-base materials on a beacon to build its base. Crouch for bulk placement; breaking the beacon can recover its base.
vpp_mod_suite.features.beaconMaximumLaye: Maximum number of automatically constructed beacon layers, from one to four.
vpp_mod_suite.features.breakBeaconBase.d: Dismantle valid beacon-base blocks when breaking the beacon.
vpp_mod_suite.features.dropReplacedBeaco: Drop replaceable blocks displaced by beacon construction. Containers and protected blocks are not replaced.
Use prismarine materials on a conduit to extend its frame. Use a conduit from range to build its frame.
vpp_mod_suite.features.conduitPlacementD: Maximum ranged conduit targeting distance, also limited by the player’s block interaction range.
vpp_mod_suite.features.breakConduitFrame: Dismantle frame materials when breaking a conduit.
vpp_mod_suite.features.dropReplacedCondu: Drop replaceable blocks displaced by conduit construction.
vpp_mod_suite.features.clearCompletedCon: Clear eligible interior blocks after the conduit frame is complete.
vpp_mod_suite.features.grindEnchantments: Add enchantment extraction and book-to-book transfer to grindstones while retaining normal grindstone recipes.
vpp_mod_suite.features.grindExtraction.d: Combine enchanted equipment with a plain book to extract enchantments.
vpp_mod_suite.features.grindTransfer.des: Move one compatible enchantment between enchanted books.
vpp_mod_suite.features.extractCurses.des: Allow extraction or transfer of curse enchantments. Disabled by default.
vpp_mod_suite.features.grindConsumeSourc: Consume equipment after extraction instead of returning it with remaining enchantments and its other data.
vpp_mod_suite.features.grindOnlyFirst.de: Extract only the first eligible enchantment onto the book.
vpp_mod_suite.features.grindCostInPoints: Charge experience points instead of experience levels.
vpp_mod_suite.features.grindExtractionFa: Multiply extracted enchantment weights by this value before adding the base cost.
vpp_mod_suite.features.grindExtractionOf: Base cost added to the weighted extraction cost.
vpp_mod_suite.features.grindTransferNorm: Cost weight for each level of a normal enchantment.
vpp_mod_suite.features.grindTransferTrea: Cost weight for each level of a treasure enchantment.
vpp_mod_suite.features.grindTransferFact: Multiply the transfer weight by this value before adding the base cost.
vpp_mod_suite.features.grindTransferOffs: Base cost added to the weighted transfer cost.
vpp_mod_suite.features.netheriteInstamin: Increase mining speed with a main-hand Efficiency V netherite axe or pickaxe and Haste II or greater.
vpp_mod_suite.features.instaminePickaxeS: Additional mining efficiency while the netherite pickaxe qualifies. Removed immediately when conditions stop applying.
vpp_mod_suite.features.instamineAxeSpeed: Additional mining efficiency while the netherite axe qualifies.
vpp_mod_suite.features.noEndermanGrief.d: Prevent Endermen from picking up blocks. Existing held blocks remain intact.
vpp_mod_suite.features.allWeatherChannel: Let Channeling trident hits on surviving living entities summon lightning in any weather, including indoors.
vpp_mod_suite.features.swiftFlight.desc: Enable flying speed bonuses from the existing Swift Flight enchantment on happy ghast harnesses. Restart after changing. Existing books and harness enchantments remain registered.
vpp_mod_suite.features.swiftFlightBookLo: Add Swift Flight enchanted books to End City treasure with an 8 percent chance. Restart after changing.
Use a writable book containing the recipient’s player name to transfer a pet you own.
vpp_mod_suite.features.callParrot.desc: Bind a goat horn while looking at this pet, then use the horn to recall it. Disable to suspend this horn type.
vpp_mod_suite.features.callNautilus.desc: Bind a goat horn while looking at this pet, then use the horn to recall it. Disable to suspend this horn type.
vpp_mod_suite.features.callHorse.desc: Bind a goat horn while looking at this pet, then use the horn to recall it. Disable to suspend this horn type.
vpp_mod_suite.features.callHappyGhast.de: Bind a goat horn while looking at this pet, then use the horn to recall it. Disable to suspend this horn type.
vpp_mod_suite.features.callDog.desc: Bind a goat horn while looking at this pet, then use the horn to recall it. Disable to suspend this horn type.
vpp_mod_suite.features.callCat.desc: Bind a goat horn while looking at this pet, then use the horn to recall it. Disable to suspend this horn type.
vpp_mod_suite.features.callCrossDimensio: Allow horns to summon bound pets across dimensions.
vpp_mod_suite.features.nautilusRequiresW: Only recall nautiluses to a safe water destination.
vpp_mod_suite.features.callMountedPets.d: Allow summoning pets with passengers, except happy ghasts which have a separate control.
vpp_mod_suite.features.callOccupiedHappy: Allow summoning happy ghasts carrying players.
vpp_mod_suite.features.callUnownedHornsS: Allow other players to use a horn bound to an animal without an owner, such as a happy ghast.
vpp_mod_suite.features.mountCalledPets.d: Mount eligible recalled animals after summoning them.
vpp_mod_suite.features.preservePetLeashe: Keep pet leash connections where possible during recall.
vpp_mod_suite.features.callHorseTypes.de: Comma-separated Minecraft entity types allowed by horse horns.
vpp_mod_suite.features.callNautilusTypes: Comma-separated Minecraft entity types allowed by nautilus horns.
